title: Work with me
description: A small, fast website for your business, written in your words. Packages from {price}.
lede: I build small websites for shops, cafés and studios: a few pages that load fast, read well on a phone and say plainly what you do.
priceNote: A fixed price, agreed before I start. It depends on how many pages and languages the site has.

example.caption: What a small tool does: {project} turned a café’s spreadsheet into this menu. The café and its menu are fictional.

items.text: Up to five pages: what you do, what it costs and where to find you.
Every page reads well on a small screen and loads in a moment.
Georgian and English, or whichever two languages your customers read.
The site runs on your own domain, with its certificate in place.
For a month after launch, I change whatever doesn’t read right.

how.heading: How it goes
steps: You tell me what you do and send what you already have: a logo, photos, a price list.
I reply with the pages I would make and a fixed price.
I build the site and send you a preview to read on your phone.
When you are happy with it, it goes live on your address.

who.heading: Who it’s for
who.text: Small businesses that need a clear site more than a big one: a shop, a café, a studio, a workshop.

contact.heading: Tell me about your business
contact.text: What do you do, and what should your site say? I reply with the pages I would make and a fixed price.
